name: InnoScience (Suzhou) Technology Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: InnoScience (Suzhou) Technology Holding Co., Ltd. designs, researches, develops, manufactures, and sells gallium nitride (GaN) power semiconductor products in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company provides GaN wafers, discrete chips, integrated circuits, and modules for use in consumer electronics, renewable energy and industrial, automotive electronics, and data centers applications. InnoScience (Suzhou) Technology Holding Co., Ltd. was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
